purpose: Teach: こんなふうに/げん/ツン/むけ/掴ん/やけに/よろしゅう/甘味

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、こんなふうに二人で旅、よく行ったな。
lines.en: We used to take trips like this, just the two of us, back when we were young.
lines.style: Nostalgic, gazing inward. Soft opening. Unhurried pace — letting the memory settle. Voice trails gently, as if half-speaking to the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。試験前、げんを担いで、息子にカツ煮、作ったわね。
lines.en: Yes. Before exams, I'd make tonkatsu to bring good luck — remember that?
lines.style: Warm recollection, eyes brightening slightly. Small conspiratorial laugh buried in the words. Gentle, present-tense affection speaking through memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫娘、最初、私にツンとしてたけど、今は懐いてる。
lines.en: Our granddaughter was so distant with me at first. Now she's grown so close.
lines.style: Quiet marvel. Slight catch of feeling in the voice — surprised at his own softness. Measured delivery, each phrase given its weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 子供むけの絵本、何冊もしまってあるわよ。
lines.en: I've kept so many picture books for the children hidden away in the cupboard.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact practicality with buried tenderness underneath. As if confessing a small secret. Slight uplift at the end — pride without claiming it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 本、しっかり掴んで読むの、お互いの習慣だね。
lines.en: The way you both hold a book tight when you read — that's become your shared habit.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical. Slow, deliberate pacing. Eyes soft, tracing the pattern. Voice carries the weight of noticing small, enduring things.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今夜、やけに静かね、外が。
lines.en: It's unusually quiet outside tonight, isn't it.
lines.style: Observant, almost musing. A slight pause before speaking — listening first. Calm, settled tone. Not quite a question, more a shared noticing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 関西から来たお客さん、よろしゅうって挨拶してた。
lines.en: That guest from Kansai greeted us so warmly earlier.
lines.style: Gentle recollection, a soft smile in the voice. Wistful — thinking of the kindness shown. Unhurried, letting the moment linger.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お茶請けの甘味、用意できてるわよ。
lines.en: I've already prepared some sweets to serve with the tea.
lines.style: Practical assurance with quiet pride. Warm, maternal tone — taking care of small things that matter. Closing cadence: settling in, ready for the evening.
